sources.usage: Project brief, enums, allowed design space, ranges, and schemas.
Public/cleared/provisional source usability registry; distinguishes formal-ready, background-only, provisional-only, and needs-review materials.
Agent-readable navigation layer for scopes, required tasks, source-use boundaries, and missing-data checklist; not a new authority source.
Submitted site boundary geometry source (provisional).
Three required detailed-design key area boundaries (provisional).
Official announcement tasks, scope levels, key areas, language, and deliverable context.
Agent-facing open-call principles, six required agent tasks, scenario/branding/operation requirements, and boundary clause.
Tero A. et al. (2010) Rules for biologically inspired adaptive network design, Science 327(5964): 439-442. Methodological basis for the bio-Physarum adaptive network.
Deb K. et al. (2002) A fast and elitist multiobjective genetic algorithm: NSGA-II, IEEE TEVC 6(2): 182-197. Optimization method for the four-objective network renewal problem.

Author's real Physarum + NSGA-II run (167-edge network, optimal efficiency 19.20, heritage objective f3≡f2 [degenerates to cost; no independent site heritage conclusion], Plan03 UDS 80.34). Method-validation evidence only; located ~2-3 km west of the provisional boundary, so not entered as formal geometry. Recorded as metric values in metrics.json and as narrative in proposal.md, not as a geometry layer.
sources.note: Run artifacts are not committed as geometry; the coordinate offset makes direct spatial reuse invalid for this site.

sources.usage: Sidewalk Labs Quayside (Toronto). Public-reporting reference for data-governance commitment mechanisms (sensor network, adaptive building, data trust; launched 2017, cancelled 2020). Used for method comparison only, not replicated.
sources.note: Public reporting / official project material; quantitative indicators to be verified against official sources (待核实).

sources.usage: Masdar City (Abu Dhabi). Public-reporting reference for low-carbon block and new feeder mobility (passive cooling, early PRT pilot). Used for method comparison only.
sources.note: Public reporting / official project material; some zero-carbon targets were later adjusted; indicators to be verified (待核实).

sources.usage: Songdo International Business District (Incheon). Public-reporting reference for new-infrastructure and urban-sensing integration (U-City, central pneumatic waste collection). Used for method comparison only.
sources.note: Public reporting / official project material; indicators to be verified (待核实).

sources.usage: Amsterdam Smart City (Netherlands). Public-reporting reference for incremental renewal and multi-party governance (living-lab pilots on energy/water/mobility). Used for method comparison only.
sources.note: Public reporting / official project material; indicators to be verified (待核实).

sources.usage: Xiong'an New Area (Hebei). Public-reporting reference for CIM digital twin, blue-green network, underground utility tunnels, and green mobility. Used for method comparison only; this proposal is renewal, not a new town.
sources.note: Public reporting / official project material; indicators to be verified (待核实).

sources.query_extent: Provisional site boundary and surrounding Line 13 subway stations (Dazhongsi, Weigongcun); roads/parks/railways screened as background only.
sources.usage: Subway station coordinates (3 OSM nodes, osm_id 6617852356 / 12435287603 / 7861046853) used as measured anchors in visual/assets/demo_data.json. Background screening of OSM roads/parks/railways informed the Physarum network context. Not used as official boundary, road redline, or engineering geometry.

Shibuya Station area redevelopment (Tokyo, 2012–): rail-station integration and four-quadrant walking network. Referenced in the case comparison table for TOD integration and four-quadrant connectivity; method reference only.
sources.note: Official project / public reporting; quantitative indicators to be verified against official sources (待核实).

sources.note: Official project / public reporting; quantitative indicators to be verified (待核实).

sources.usage: Copenhagen bicycle-priority network and dedicated bridges (2006–). Referenced for slow-mobility priority and dedicated facilities; method reference only.
sources.note: Official project / public reporting; quantitative indicators to be verified (待核实).

sources.usage: Punggol Digital District (Singapore, 2018–): district-wide digital twin and open digital platform. Referenced for the digital foundation of industry-university-research integration; method reference only.
sources.note: Official project / public reporting; quantitative indicators to be verified (待核实).

sources.usage: Cheonggyecheon restoration (Seoul, 2003–2005): elevated-highway removal and stream restoration into blue-green public space. Referenced for blue-green restoration and elevated-highway removal; method reference only.

sources.usage: GB 50763-2012《无障碍设计规范》(Code for accessibility design), mandatory national standard (MOHURD + AQSIQ, 2012). Used as the accessibility-threshold basis (无障碍阈值) throughout the proposal and the T-01/T-03 test scenarios.
sources.note: Official national standard; full text disclosed via 国家标准全文公开系统 (openstd.samr.gov.cn).

sources.usage: GB/T 51328-2018《城市综合交通体系规划标准》(Standard for urban comprehensive transport system planning), recommended national standard. Used as the basis for transport/rail/slow-travel planning in the test scenarios.
sources.note: Official national standard; full text disclosed via 国家标准全文公开系统 (openstd.samr.gov.cn).

sources.usage: GB 50014《室外排水设计标准》(Standard for design of outdoor wastewater engineering), national engineering-construction standard. Used as the basis for stormwater/drainage resilience in the T-02 Xiaoyue River sponge-city test scenario.
sources.note: Official national standard; current edition GB 50014-2021; full text disclosed via 国家标准全文公开系统 (openstd.samr.gov.cn).

sources.usage: 《海绵城市建设技术指南——低影响开发雨水系统构建（试行）》(MOHURD, 2014). Used as the sponge-city technical-guide basis for permeable-paving and green-infiltration ratios in the T-02 test scenario.
